purpose: Approved PhoenixGuard V3 overlay vocabulary for backend filtering, dashboard rendering, diagnostics, and certification.

rules.execution_authority: Overlays explain the decision surface only. Execution authority remains PG_EXECUTION_PACKET_V3 and ShooterActionSequencerV2.
rules.unknown_live_labels: Labels outside approved_labels must not render in live modes. They are collected as unknown_or_unmapped_terms and exposed in diagnostics.
rules.clean_live_now_budget: CLEAN_LIVE may show at most one CURRENT/NOW label.
rules.council_mode: COUNCIL renders reasoning markers only, not chart box spam.

mode_summary.GLOBAL: Global structure and major context only.
mode_summary.LOCAL: Local structure, pullback, retest, continuation context.
mode_summary.SUPPLY_DEMAND: Horizontal supply, demand, and opposing force zones only.
mode_summary.TRENDLINES: Diagonal support, resistance, and inner trendlines only.
mode_summary.TARGET: Target and opposing force path room without invalidation boxes.
mode_summary.INVALIDATION: Reserved guardrail context; invalidation boxes are not drawn by GUI modes and are available only to deep debug/inspector audits.
mode_summary.PATH: Path, angle vector, and verified historical progression.
mode_summary.COUNCIL: Reasoning markers and compact decision state.
mode_summary.REPLAY: Replay entry, exit, would-have and memory-match objects.
mode_summary.DIAGNOSTICS: Raw, rejected, stale, transform, scene graph, collision, and unknown terms.

label_definitions.SUPPLY: Horizontal supply zone or supply area. It is not a diagonal resistance trendline.
label_definitions.DEMAND: Horizontal demand zone or demand area. It is not a diagonal support trendline.
label_definitions.SUPPORT TRENDLINE: Validated wick-to-wick support line. It must not cut through candles after the anchor touches.
label_definitions.RESISTANCE TRENDLINE: Validated wick-to-wick resistance line. It must not cut through candles after the anchor touches.
label_definitions.INNER TRENDLINE: Local microstructure trendline from recent candles. It supports the active pullback or continuation read.
label_definitions.REPLAY ENTRY: Historical entry marker used only in full-history or replay views.
label_definitions.REPLAY EXIT: Historical exit marker used only in full-history or replay views.
label_definitions.WOULD HAVE ENTERED: Replay-only marker for the entry area that would have been considered during that historical leg.
label_definitions.WOULD HAVE EXITED: Replay-only marker for the exit or target area that would have closed the historical leg.
label_definitions.HISTORICAL PROGRESSION: Historical sequence box or path. It explains replay context and must not be treated as live authority.

vlm_contract.role: The VLM explains PhoenixGuard overlay and council context in English; it must not create independent trade predictions.
vlm_contract.visible_label_rule: Use approved_labels for any operator-visible label.
vlm_contract.metadata_rule: Use object type, layer, side, confidence, reason, replay_sequence, trendline_role, and skill_gate metadata for explanations.
vlm_contract.authority_rule: Execution authority remains the canonical execution packet and shooter sequencer, not the VLM narrative.
